
A speaker (or fan) of [[Lojban|Lojban]].  Term coined by [[User:Mark Shoulson|Mark Shoulson]].  Face it, it's a more amusing term than [[Lojbanist|Lojbanist]].

Possibly from Esperanto ''Lojxbanano''?

No, not when I coined it.  I think I was reacting to the flap about [[About Lojbani|lojbani]] sounding too eastern, and thought it was a funny-sounding name.  I don't remember thinking Esperanto at the time (but who knows?)
